records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales for the nine months ended September 30, 2021, were up 19% from the prior year period.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Core brand gross billing increased by 22% to $14,199 compared to the same period last year, driven by Reed’s volume growth of 34% and Virgil’s volume growth of 16%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The sales growth focus is on channel expansion, new product introduction and improved sales execution.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The margin enhancement initiative is driven by co-packer upgrades, better leveraged purchasing, and improved efficiency.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In addition, the company is implementing several measures to increase capacity and to offset inflationary pressure from increased pricing of raw material inputs and transportation.
